INSERT INTO market_price_bars(stock_id,provider,feed,resolution,adjustment,interval_start,interval_end, open_price,high_price,low_price,close_price,revision,fetched_at) VALUES
(#{b.stockId},'ALPACA','iex','1Min','raw',#{b.intervalStart},#{b.intervalEnd}, #{b.openPrice},#{b.highPrice},#{b.lowPrice},#{b.closePrice},1,#{b.fetchedAt})
AS v ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE revision=market_price_bars.revision + IF(market_price_bars.open_price <> v.open_price OR market_price_bars.high_price <> v.high_price OR market_price_bars.low_price <> v.low_price OR market_price_bars.close_price <> v.close_price,1,0), open_price=v.open_price,high_price=v.high_price,low_price=v.low_price,close_price=v.close_price,fetched_at=v.fetched_at
